title: 姚明：美国职业篮球联赛欧洲扩张？我祝成功
speaker: Yao Ming

segments.en: Are you in any talks, you have any interest in potentially being part of the ownership process?
segments.zh: 你是否参与过谈判？是否有兴趣成为NBA欧洲联赛的拥有者之一？

segments.en: That's a big news. Obviously, it's a very big news, and I have a few European friends who were talking to each other once a while to see how they're going.
segments.zh: 这是个重大新闻。显然，这是个大新闻，我有一些欧洲朋友，我们偶尔会聊聊他们的进展。

segments.en: Now, I wish all the success. I'm sure NBA have their rich experience to help this being success, and I'm sure they will bring this sport to another level.
segments.zh: 我祝愿一切成功。我相信NBA有丰富的经验来帮助这件事成功，我也相信他们会把这项运动带到一个新高度。
